Patch tests are easy to ensure you don't experience any initial adverse reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test before starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps: 1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow 2. Keep the area dry 3. Answers that we believe must be heard. Frequently asked questions About 5 % AHA BHA Exfoliating Bodywash for Women What’s this product for? What do you mean by dual exfoliation? This advanced body wash provides dual exfoliation. It uses natural perlite beads (derived from volcanic ash) and encapsulated salicylic acid beads for gentle physical exfoliation, buffing away dead skin cells. The AHA/BHA combination (glycolic and lactic acid/salicylic acid) provides deeper chemical exfoliation, unclogs pores, reduces the appearance of "strawberry skin" and bumps, and promotes cell turnover. Lactic acid also adds a hydrating benefit. I am new to exfoliation; what should I know about this product? Exfoliation is the way to smoother skin! This body wash uses both AHAs (glycolic and lactic acid) and BHAs (salicylic acid) for gentle exfoliation. If you're new to exfoliating, start by using it 2-3 times a week and gradually increase to daily use as your skin adjusts. Discontinue use if you experience any irritation. Why do I need to use SPF after any AHA-BHA products? AHAs and BHAs, while incredibly effective can also make your skin more sensitive to the sun. Using a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of 30 or higher every day is crucial to protect your skin from sun damage. Think of it as protecting your newly revealed, radiant skin! Can I use this product on my face? This product is formulated for use on the body and may be too potent for the delicate skin on your face. We recommend using products specifically designed for facial exfoliation. Won't this product be harsh on my body? Can I use it everyday? While this product contains powerful exfoliants, it's also formulated with nourishing ingredients like shea butter and oils to help soothe and moisturise the skin. However, everyone's skin is different. We recommend starting with 2-3 uses per week and gradually increasing to daily use as your skin tolerates it. If you experience any redness, dryness, or irritation, reduce usage or discontinue use. How does it help with razor bumps and ingrown hair? " The glycolic and lactic acids provide deep exfoliation, while salicylic acid (a BHA) helps prevent and treat ingrown hairs and razor bumps. Salicylic acid gently exfoliates the skin's surface and unclogs pores, allowing hairs to grow out properly and reducing redness, inflammation, and bumps. " What are the benefits of this body wash? This body wash is formulated to address rough, bumpy skin through dual exfoliation while also hydrating and nourishing. It's an excellent solution for body acne, tan reduction, and pigmentation concerns. While providing deep exfoliation, it's also designed to be hydrating and non-drying.
